data.name: The Seal of R'lyeh
data.summary: A Lovecraftian expansion: the Occultist class (levels 1–20, four cults), two races – Innsmouth-Marked and Ghouls – a Wizard subclass, a skill tree for everyone, Eldritch Exposure & madness, and Withers' forbidden wares.

modfile.changelog:
Version 2.0 – "The Thousand Faces"

NEW CULT: CHURCH OF THE THOUSAND FACES (Nyarlathotep)
- Level 3: Dissonant Whispers, Charm Person, Mask of Many Faces (Disguise Self at will) and Seed of Discord.
- Level 6: The Black Man – when hit, show your true face as a reaction: the attacker is frightened and gains Eldritch Exposure.
- Level 10: The Black Pharaoh – once per long rest, deeply exposed enemies fight at your side.

NEW RACE: GHOULS
- Two subraces: Changeling and Dreamlands Ghoul. Grave Chill, Corpse Lore, Hunger and the Ghoul's Bite.
- Full appearance options in character creation, with a pale "Decay" skin by default.

NEW WIZARD SUBCLASS: SCHOOL OF FORBIDDEN LORE
- Copy Occultist spells into your spellbook (levels 2, 6 and 10).
- Marginalia, The Price of Knowledge, Mind at the Edge and The Necronomicon Opens.
- Added via Larian's progression merging – the Wizard's own data is not overwritten, so it works alongside other Wizard subclass mods.

LEVELS 13–20 (requires a level cap mod)
- The Occultist now has spell slots, spells and Forbidden Knowledge up to level 20.
- Five Mythic Rites: The Blasted Heath (13), Call the Star-Spawn (15), Dagon's Flood (17), The Gate and the Key (19), He Dreams No More (20).
- Level 17: No Mind Left to Lose. Level 20 capstone: The Seal Breaks.
- New cult features at level 14 for all four cults, and a second use of the level 10 power at level 18.

NEW 6TH-LEVEL SPELLS
- Call of a Shoggoth, The Hounds of Tindalos, The Shining Trapezohedron – plus Circle of Death, Eyebite and Harm.

LIBRARY OF MADNESS
- Fourth branch: Branch of the Thousand Faces – False Face, Whispered Discord, The Crawling Chaos, Face of the Messenger.

WITHERS' WARES (Act 2 & 3)
- Mask of the Yellow King (level 6), Mi-Go Carapace (level 8), Ring of the Trapezohedron (level 10).
- New consumables: Brine Vial (lowers Eldritch Exposure) and Dreamweed (advantage on Wisdom saves).

NEW BACKGROUND: SCHOLAR OF MISKATONIC
- Arcana and Investigation, plus seminar notes in your pack.

OTHER
- The Occultist now counts as both Wizard and Sorcerer for dialogue options.
- All new spells, items, races and classes have custom hand-drawn icons.

Existing saves work. Start a new character to play the Ghouls, the new background or the Wizard subclass.

data.name: Priest
data.summary: Play a Wisdom-based Priest with Holy, Dark, and Blood paths, custom rites, and ceremonial focuses. Early alpha for co-op playtesting: the class is overtuned and some features are broken. Balance and bug fixes will follow.

modfile.changelog:
Priest 1.0.0.14 - Alpha
- Fixed Bone Chill's icon, spell identity and casting action.
- Merchant refreshes offer two distinct Priest focuses alongside the three core hymnals; surplus focus stock is cleaned up on refresh.
- Updated Sheltered by Faith's level scaling, per-hit decay and rest restoration.
- Includes Aegis of Mercy and Renewing Prayer, available to learn from Priest level 5.

Known issue: book and focus bonus damage still does not display correctly in spell tooltips. This update does not fix that display issue.

Still an overtuned Alpha with known bugs.

data.name: ClassAttributeTrade
data.summary: Adds an optional Class Passives step at character creation: trade -1 in one ability for +1 in another, so you can reach 18 in an ability score. Works with any race and class.

modfile.changelog:
1.0.0 - Initial release.
- Adds an optional "Class Passives" step at character creation.
- Trade -1 in one ability for +1 in another, so you can reach 18 in an ability score.
- Works with any race and with the 12 base classes.
- Classes added by other mods are not covered.

data.name: Arcane Armoury
data.summary: An arcane armoury; using Spellcasting Modifier for the weaponry.

modfile.changelog:
Arcane Weaponry v1.0.1.4
Fixed various tooltip issues

Arcane Weaponry v1.0.1
Rare Weaponry now correctly uses spellcasting modifier

Arcane Weaponry v1.0
A new armoury of weapons focussed on Spellcasting Modifier
Rare tier weaponry gained Faint Arcane Guidance: Uses spellcasting modifier for attack roll and deals an additional 2 Force damage per weapon attack:
•	Dagger of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Piercing
•	Greatsword of the Faltering Weave: 2d6 Slashing
•	Light Hammer of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Bludgeoning
•	Longsword of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Slashing / 2d6 Piercing
•	Rapier of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Piercing
•	Shortsword of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Piercing
•	Spear of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Piercing / 2d6 Piercing
•	Druidic Staff of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Bludgeoning / 2d6 Bludgeoning
•	Staff of the Faltering Weave: 1d8 Bludgeoning / 2d6 Bludgeoning
The price of these items is set at 600 gold pieces. 
They are available at Dammon in the Druids Grove, and Grat the Trader in Goblin camp during Act 1. 
They are available at Danthelon in Wyrm’s Crossing in Act 3. 

Very Rare tier weaponry gained Arcane Guidance; Uses spellcasting modifier for attack roll and deals additional Force damage equal to spellcasting modifier. It also gifts a once per long rest, bonus action Mage Armour.
For the full description of the new skills and abilities, see the attached screenshots. 
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Ice-Knife: 2d4 Piercing | Gained Knife to Meet you | Gained Fast Hands
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Crackle: 2d4 Slashing / 3d4 Slashing | Gained Lightning Gale | Gained Imperial Retaliation
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Needle: 2d4 Piercing | Gained Dueller’s Enthusiasm | Gained Arcane Forces
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Dancer: 2d4 Slashing | Gained Hush You | Gained Dextrous Weapon
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Gift: 2d4 Piercing | Gained Arcane Absorption | Gained Battle Acuity
•	Archmagos Zrexis’ Folly: 2d4 Slashing | Gained Death’s Touch | Gained Frank the Skeleton Man
•	ThimbleWhistle’s Parting Gift: 2d4 Force / 3d4 Force | Gained Hey! What’s over There? | Gained Stop That!
•	Inervating Sourcery of Fire: 2d4 Psychic / 3d4 Psychic | Gained Fireball! | Gained Arcane Enchantment
•	Gift of the Greenwood: 2d4 Acid / 3d4 Acid |Gained Summon Kevin the Dastardly Squirrel | Gained Elemental Forcers
•	Archmagos Zrexis’ Staff: 2d4 Necrotic / 3d4 Necrotic | Gained Summon my Pretty Boy! | Gained Zrexis’ Anger
•	Grandmaester Logan’s Greatsword: 3d4 Slashing | Gained Radiant Boom | Gained Radiating Shockwave Blast
•	Maester Connough’s Flail: 2d4 Radiant | Gained Radiant Darkness | Gained Divine Sight

All weapons of the very rare variety have been given a description that details the life of ThimbleWhistle and Zrexis. 
Prices have been set at 2.000 gold pieces and the items are available at Tali the Quartermaster in Last Light Inn and Lann Tarv at Moonrise Towers in Act 2. The items are also available at Danthelon in Wyrms Crossing in Act 3.
